subject: The MPlus error message prior to "MODEL FIT INFORMATION"

messages.author: 5ab2990ae3925d41
messages.subject: The MPlus error message prior to "MODEL FIT INFORMATION"
parts:
Hi,
 
I just updated the MplusAutmoation to the latest version, and it works very well, especially for reading in data (not sure why it didn't work previous though). I found that although the "readModels" command can now read warnings (like "*** WARNING") from the output, I am not sure if reads the error message sometimes Mplus gives when the model terminatesly normally. Below is an example.
 
Is there anyway to get it, because when number of models is huge, it is impossible to check the output file one by one, yet it could imply distrubst for the model results, as well as influence the other functions in the MplusAutomation - for example when this happens, somehow I could no longer read in the saved factor scores.
 
Thanks a lot! -Kate

THE MODEL ESTIMATION TERMINATED NORMALLY
     WARNING:  THE RESIDUAL COVARIANCE MATRIX (THETA) IS NOT POSITIVE DEFINITE.
     THIS COULD INDICATE A NEGATIVE VARIANCE/RESIDUAL VARIANCE FOR AN OBSERVED
     VARIABLE, A CORRELATION GREATER OR EQUAL TO ONE BETWEEN TWO OBSERVED
     VARIABLES, OR A LINEAR DEPENDENCY AMONG MORE THAN TWO OBSERVED VARIABLES.
     CHECK THE RESULTS SECTION FOR MORE INFORMATION.
     PROBLEM INVOLVING VARIABLE KPSE1882.

     WARNING:  THE RESIDUAL COVARIANCE MATRIX (THETA) IS NOT POSITIVE DEFINITE.
     THIS COULD INDICATE A NEGATIVE VARIANCE/RESIDUAL VARIANCE FOR AN OBSERVED
     VARIABLE, A CORRELATION GREATER OR EQUAL TO ONE BETWEEN TWO OBSERVED
     VARIABLES, OR A LINEAR DEPENDENCY AMONG MORE THAN TWO OBSERVED VARIABLES.
     CHECK THE RESULTS SECTION FOR MORE INFORMATION.
     PROBLEM INVOLVING VARIABLE KPSE1882.

     FACTOR SCORES COULD NOT BE COMPUTED.  AT LEAST ONE OF THE RESIDUAL
     VARIANCES FOR THE CATEGORICAL VARIABLES IS NOT POSITIVE.
 
MODEL FIT INFORMATION
Number of Free Parameters                      194
Chi-Square Test of Model Fit
          Value                            634.872*
          Degrees of Freedom                   401
          P-Value                           0.0000

messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: The MPlus error message prior to "MODEL FIT INFORMATION"
parts:
Hi Kate,

This is a good idea: it would be useful to get warnings from models that terminate normally, but with potentially dubious results. I'll put this on my to do list. The main problem, I think, will be to track down whether these messages are printed out in a consistent position and format in the output files. My experience is that they're usually just below the "terminated normally" message, so I look there.

Best,
Michael

messages.author: 885539f3f5ae8fd5
messages.subject: Re: The MPlus error message prior to "MODEL FIT INFORMATION"
parts:
Hi,

Just to add to this: I'm not able to pick up the below error message with readModels:

RANDOM STARTS RESULTS RANKED FROM THE BEST TO THE WORST LOGLIKELIHOOD VALUES

1 perturbed starting value run(s) did not converge.
Final stage loglikelihood values at local maxima, seeds, and initial stage start numbers:

4 perturbed starting value run(s) did not converge.

     THE MODEL ESTIMATION DID NOT TERMINATE NORMALLY DUE TO AN INSUFFICIENT
     NUMBER OF E STEPS.  INCREASE THE NUMBER OF MITERATIONS.  ESTIMATES
     CANNOT BE TRUSTED.

THE BEST LOGLIKELIHOOD VALUE HAS BEEN REPLICATED.  RERUN WITH AT LEAST TWICE THE
RANDOM STARTS TO CHECK THAT THE BEST LOGLIKELIHOOD IS STILL OBTAINED AND REPLICATED.

Right after this is a gap in the output of several lines, which is where the model fit information would normally be provided.

Best,
Jon

messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: The MPlus error message prior to "MODEL FIT INFORMATION"
parts:
Hi all,

Thanks for providing another example of warnings/errors that need to be registered by readModels. A fellow Github user (patr1ckm) was kind enough to provide initial code to read estimation errors and warnings. I adapted and extended this code and just merged it all into the development version of the package. This is a particularly tricky section to parse because of its irregular format and position in the output file, so please forward me output files where the warnings and errors are not handled appropriately. I will try to roll this and other changes out to CRAN soon for general use.

require(devtools)

install_github("MplusAutomation", "michaelhallquist")

Best,
Michael
